structure_checker.planning_behavior: Convert structure validation into plan requirements for explicit sections, measurable acceptance, and testable output shape.
constraints: Plan the expected output structure before execution.
Define checks that can prove required sections are present.
Avoid relying on visual or prose inspection alone when a structural check is practical.

scope_check.planning_behavior: Convert scope validation into plan requirements for preserving the original objective and avoiding silent scope drift.
constraints: State scope and non-scope before execution.
Map every task step back to the original objective.
Record scope expansion as an escalation condition.

security_review_executor.planning_behavior: Convert security review principles into pre-implementation threat, permission, evidence, and mitigation constraints.
constraints: Identify trust boundaries and sensitive data before execution.
Plan least-privilege access and secret-safety checks.
Define security evidence needed for closeout.

audit_only_executor.planning_behavior: Convert audit behavior into plan requirements for evidence gathering and finding-to-action mapping without implementing fixes.
constraints: Require evidence citations for every planned finding.
Convert findings into scoped follow-up tasks only after the audit is complete.
